name: Pilisszentlászló (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pilisszentlászló (a blue shield with a white horseman, within a green wreath, above a scroll inscribed Pilisszentlászló) below the name SENVÁCLAV in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Pilisszentlászló arms with wreath and scroll
